question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

The act of washing oneself
solution:
The correct answer is option 1), i.e., 'Ablutions.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the marked option:

 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Ablutions
 an act of washing oneself. (स्नान)
 
 
 
 
 
• Example:
 
 
• *​Hurriedly she finished her **ablutions**, pulled on her clothes and went to investigate.*
 
 
 
• ​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:
 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Solutions
 the answer to a problem. (किसी समस्या का उत्तर)
 
 

 Steaming
 producing steam. (भाप का उत्पादन)
 
 

 Bathing
 wash (someone) while immersing them in a bath; wash oneself while immersed in a bath. (नहाना)
 
 
 
 
 
• Hence, from the given meanings, we find that 'Ablutions' is the correct one-word substitute.
 
• So, the correct answer is option 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• As nouns the difference between bathing and ablution is that **bathing **is the act of taking a bath while **ablution **is the act of washing something.
